text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though Meisho Doto had pulled off an 
unexpected victory over T.M. Opera O in 
the Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Completely bewildered, she flails about in 
a panic. Eventually, she exhausts all her 
energy and willpower, collapsing on the 
spot.
